title: Add remediation-oriented work-item and task validation
objective: Implement sdlc work-item validate --work-item <work-item-id> and sdlc task validate --task <task identifier> so schema validation covers every selected object and reference validation always runs, including after schema failures, with actionable remediation context for coding agents, then deliver the change as version 0.5.0.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository uses main for active work and the existing master release ref remains the release boundary.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to implement an sdlc work-item validate --work-item <work-item-id> and sdlc task validate --task <task identifier sdlc/task-identifier/v1>

Validate must perform schema level validation of all objects in the work item or the specified task. It must also validate all references. If schema validation fails, we still must perform reference validation. This will be used by a coding agent and the results from validate must provide sufficient context for remediation to occur.

Commit the work item.

Process the new work item, commit per task. Additional requirement: bump the minor version from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0 upon completion.

scope.name: work-item-validation-command
scope.description: Implement sdlc work-item validate --work-item <work-item-id> as complete selected-tree validation.
scope.reason: Agents need one command to validate work-item.json, every task envelope/payload, and all references in scope.

scope.name: task-validation-command
scope.description: Implement sdlc task validate --task <task identifier> using the canonical sdlc/task-identifier/v1 grammar.
scope.reason: Agents also need a narrow validation boundary for one task without validating unrelated work items.

scope.name: schema-and-reference-continuation
scope.description: Always perform reference discovery, syntax validation, and local target validation even when one or more object schema validations fail.
scope.reason: Schema failures must not hide independent reference failures needed for remediation.

scope.name: remediation-context
scope.description: Return stable per-object and per-reference findings with source paths, JSON/YAML locations, schema paths, reference text, target/context, reason, and remediation guidance.
scope.reason: The output is consumed by coding agents that need sufficient context to correct failures without re-discovering the problem.

scope.name: per-task-test-gates
scope.description: Require a complete passing unit-test gate before every implementation and validation task commit.
scope.reason: Validation behavior spans CLI parsing, schema execution, reference traversal, task selection, response schemas, and error continuation.

nonGoals.name: mutation-or-repair
nonGoals.description: Do not modify, normalize, repair, or migrate validated work-item/task documents.
nonGoals.reason: Validation is read-only and remediation remains with the coding agent.

nonGoals.name: lifecycle-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change work-item status, task status, processingStatus, or validation records.

nonGoals.name: remote-resolution
nonGoals.description: Do not contact remote repositories, providers, or registries.
nonGoals.reason: Reference validation is local to the selected work-item/task scope.

nonGoals.name: remote-release-publication
nonGoals.description: Do not publish or deploy the package; only prepare the local versioned release candidate.
nonGoals.reason: The requested release is local and does not include remote publication or deployment.

items.name: work-item-command
items.description: sdlc work-item validate --work-item <work-item-id> must validate the selected work-item.json and every task envelope and selected task payload below its stepsPath.
items.reason: Agents need complete object-tree validation for one work item.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid work item returns a stable report with every object, schema path, object validity, and zero reference findings when all references are valid.
Unknown or malformed work-item IDs return actionable non-zero errors without writes.

items.name: task-command
items.description: sdlc task validate --task <task identifier> must accept only sdlc/task-identifier/v1 canonical task UIDs and validate exactly the selected task envelope, payload, and references.
items.reason: Agents need a narrow task validation boundary with canonical identifier enforcement.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid task identifier produces a single-task report; bare work-item IDs, pipe-separated IDs, malformed IDs, and missing tasks produce actionable errors.

items.name: reference-continuation
items.description: Reference validation must run for every selected document even when schema validation fails for the work item, task envelope, or task payload.
items.reason: Independent reference failures are necessary remediation context and must not be hidden by schema failures.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A fixture with both schema-invalid content and an invalid/missing reference reports both categories in one response.
Malformed content that prevents structural traversal yields an explicit reference-validation limitation/finding rather than silently omitting reference validation.

items.name: remediation-response
items.description: Validation findings must provide stable remediation context for coding agents.
items.reason: A finding without source location, category, reason, and suggested remediation requires the agent to repeat discovery.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Schema findings identify object path, schema path, category, validator detail, and remediation guidance.
Reference findings identify source path, value/location, reference text, scope/target, category, reason, and remediation guidance.

items.name: read-only-and-test-gate
items.description: Validation is read-only and every implementation/validation task requires a complete passing unit-test gate.
items.reason: Validation must be safe to run in an agent worktree and continuously regression-tested.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Validation leaves all selected and unrelated files byte-for-byte unchanged and every task result records a passed full test command.

items.name: minor-release-050
items.description: After all WI-0021 implementation and validation tasks pass, bump the package minor version from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0 and verify the compiled launcher reports 0.5.0.
items.reason: The user explicitly requires a minor version bump upon completion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.5.0, the compiled launcher reports 0.5.0, and final delivery checks pass before the release commit.
